body.statement: Low's two-point expected-length argument lower-bounds the expected length of a confidence interval having prescribed uniform coverage by combining parameter separation with the testing affinity of two data laws.

source.verbatim_statement: Suppose that C(X) is a confidence set for the linear functional Tf, with coverage probability of at least 1 - alpha over the convex parameter space F. If P_f0 is the actual distribution generating X, it follows that, for any epsilon > 0, E_f0 m(C(X)) >= (1 - alpha - epsilon/4) omega(f0, epsilon, F).
